verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਫਲੁ ਵਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhaa kar haranaakhasai vekhahu fal vaTe|

en.bdb: Hirrtyakyapu talked adversely about God and the result gained is clear that he eventually got killed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੰਕ ਲੁਟਾਈ ਰਾਵਣੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਸ ਕਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: la(n)k luTaiee raavanai masatak dhas kaTe|

en.bdb: Ravan also for the same reason got Lanka looted and his ten heads slayed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਸੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਣ ਲਸਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਦੈਤ ਸੰਘਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)s giaa san lasakarai sabh dhait sa(n)ghaTe|

en.bdb: Kans was killed along with his full army and his all the demons perished.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੰਸੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕੈਰਵਾਂ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਲਖ ਫਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: va(n)s gavaiaa kairavaa(n) khoohan lakh faTe|

en.bdb: The Kauravas lost their dynasty and got their myriads of army destroyed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੰਤ ਬਕਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਸਪਾਲ ਦੇ ਦੰਦ ਹੋਏ ਖਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)t bakatr sisapaal dhe dha(n)dh hoe khaTe|

en.bdb: For the same reason, Dantavaktr and Siupál got crushing defeat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਿਓ ਇਉ ਵੇਦ ਉਘਟੇ।
verses.translit_en: ni(n)dhaa koi na sijhio iau vedh ughaTe|

en.bdb: The Vedas also dilineate that no success is possible through back-biting

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਬਾਸੇ ਨੇ ਸਰਾਪ ਦੇ ਯਾਦਵ ਸਭ ਤਟੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: dhurabaase ne saraap dhe yaadhav sabh taTe ||5||

en.bdb: . (Due to this vilification) Durvasà. cursed Yadays and vanquished them all.
